title: [Epic] Marketplace and connector auto-shelf — E1 platform prerequisites (openapi/mcp hardening, outbound OAuth, request signing), E2 administrator credential hand-off, E3 author recipes and handbook, E4 the first shelf of official connector apps
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ④ coordination parent, on a maintainer ruling. The maintainer in this session, 2026-10-28, verbatim: 「是否建议立专题卡统一处理。」 → (the seat recommended a second epic, separate from #27108) → 「同意」. Filed by `session_01J8VVAjRKqdoEYQ4hXxtBuf`. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No `domain:*` on the parent: the children span `spec`, `server`, `ui`, `devx`, `skills` and the cloud repository; triage labels each child. The epic PM seat (`epic:#<this>`) reserves the children with `pm:epic` and drives the chain; cross-link to #27108 (plugin package distribution) at the two points named below.

## 维护者速读

北极星第④步「发布并装进一个环境」在**集成**这一面的闭环：外部系统（官方 OpenAPI 规范、远程 MCP 服务器）零代码变成市场里可装的"连接器应用"；客户的管理员在控制台填凭证而不是运维设环境变量；写应用的 agent 有 skills 配方与上架手册可循；首批二三十个官方连接器应用上架。与 #27108 的分工：那边是"代码插件装得进、跑得起、拦得住"，这边是"不写代码的集成进市场"。

## The road this epic closes

Survey of 2026-10-27 (cloud session, figures with their sources in #26709 / #26710): of the official MCP Registry's 50,913 servers and the official vendor OpenAPI documents, today's providers can instantiate roughly a third of the former and a tenth to a fifth of the latter, with two silent failure modes (Swagger 2.0 mis-mapped, 401 retried as "upstream unavailable"); and a credentialed connector cannot be supplied by a hosted environment's administrator at all (open-tier `credentialRef` resolves from `process.env` only). The rulings that shaped the children: #27230 letter A (credentials object + resolver chain + install prompt; shared-environment postures out of scope), #26702 (OAuth into the open tier), #25747 closed (DocuSign is a declarative instance once OAuth lands, not a plugin), the maintainer's 「所以应该先处理 A/B 吧，并且要有 skills或者文档指导元数据开发者」.

## Milestones and children

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane (triage decides) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **E1 — platform prerequisites** | #26709 auto-shelf readiness: declarative `include` + loud Swagger 2.0 refusal (`connector-openapi`); `tools/list` pagination, fatal 401, tool-snapshot hash (`connector-mcp`); offline spec-normalization tool | — | server |
| | #26702 outbound OAuth in the open tier: authorization-code / client-credentials / app-credential exchange, refreshed per dispatch, for openapi / mcp / rest; successor ADR | — | skills (ADR) → spec → server → ui |
| | #26710 request-signing auth kind (RSA2 / HMAC canonical-request signers) for openapi and rest | shares #26702's ADR | spec → server |
| **E2 — credential hand-off** | #27237 `sys_connector_credential`, resolver chain env → object → vault, reconcile on change, install-local prompt | — | server |
| | #27238 Setup → Integrations → Connector credentials page; install dialog credential step | #27237 | ui |
| **E3 — author surface** | #27223 skills: "integrations are declared, not coded", per-archetype recipes, the DocuSign eval | recipes carry `include` / `oauth2` / `signed` only as E1's cards land | skills (Tier H) |
| | #27240 marketplace handbook for app authors | — | devx |
| **E4 — the first shelf** | #27302 ruled **A, phased** (ruling 6486157794, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-29): an official connector app's edition follows the ADR-0097 / ADR-0143 capability line — every key on the open tier ⇒ **open edition**, a metadata package in this repository validated by its CI; an enterprise capability (vault-backed resolver, per-tenant connection lifecycle) or a commercial-only provider ⇒ **commercial edition** in the cloud repository. Today's whole list is open-tier, so the first shelf is open edition. Parked until E1 + E2 land; then start with only the apps the Done-when needs (DocuSign for the OAuth path + two or three static-key apps), one card per batch (static-key; OAuth after #26702; signature after #26710), growing toward 20–30 on customer pull; ingestion and listing generation stay cloud-repository work | #26709, #27237 (via #27302) | devx / cloud |

**Cross-links with #27108.** (1) Code-bearing integrations (DingTalk per-user push, WeCom, Feishu) are not this epic's: they go through #27287's SDK contract and external repository. (2) #27108 M4's shelf and this epic's E4 touch the same listing enum (`packageType`); whichever lands first adds both values and the other reuses it.

## Done-when

A fresh environment with no env vars: an administrator installs a connector app from the marketplace, is prompted for its credential, fills it on the page, a flow `connector_action` dispatches against the vendor sandbox, and an agent reaches the wrapping `ai.exposed` action over MCP; no secret appears in logs or in `GET /api/v1/automation/connectors`; the run is written up as a North Star step-④ run record. E3's eval refuses the "write a plugin" answer. E4 lists at least 20 connector apps, each with provenance (upstream, commit, sha256) on its listing.

## Risks the children inherit

- Prime Directive #10: recipes and the handbook name no key the runtime does not deliver at their base; forthcoming pieces are named by card.
- Licences: vendor specs are packaged only under MIT / Apache / CC0; proprietary or unlicensed documents (HubSpot, Alipay v3 today) are referenced by URL and fetched at install, never redistributed (#26709's shelf gate).
- Hosted runtimes shipping the `openapi` / `mcp` / `rest` provider plugins by default is **unverified**; if they do not, that is a finding filed under E1 before E4 can ship to the cloud.
- Shared-environment postures (`group` / `isolated`) are out of scope for credentials (#27230 S1) and therefore for E4 on those postures.

## Related

#27108 (sibling epic) · #27230 (ruling A) · #25747 (closed, pointer) · #26582 (closed) · ADR-0097 · ADR-0019 · ADR-0022 / 0023 / 0024 · `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` step ④.
